Translate TBU therapeutic and portfolio priorities into a differentiated global site-network strategy, defining where, with whom, and how Thermo Fisher should build strategic site relationships to support current and future clinical development needs. Establish the global strategic framework for site partnerships, including partnership segmentation, value propositions, engagement principles, governance, decision rights, escalation pathways, and standards for relationship development and activation. Lead the global operating model that connects enterprise and TBU strategy with regional Site Network Leads, Feasibility & Site Selection (FSS), Country Operations, and local site teams, enabling one connected strategy with clear ownership and accountability. Define and govern a global performance framework and differentiated KPIs that demonstrate the operational, strategic, customer, and business value of site partnerships, including proof points that inform investment and prioritization decisions. Use data, analytics, external market intelligence, and network insights to identify strategic opportunities, anticipate risks, inform network design, and recommend changes to partnership strategy and operating model. Champion innovative partnership models, digital capabilities, data-sharing approaches, and collaboration mechanisms that strengthen site engagement and differentiate Thermo Fisher in the clinical research ecosystem. Lead organizational transformation and change initiatives that position Site Strategy & Collaborations as a strategic enterprise capability rather than a transactional or support function. Advise senior and executive leadership on site ecosystem trends, strategic partnership opportunities, competitive dynamics, investment choices, and organizational capabilities required to support future growth. Desirable ●     Experience with multi-axis motion control and drive configuration. ●     Background with PLCs, microcontrollers, or LabVIEW programming. ●     Exposure to vacuum control systems, temperature monitoring, and high-precision sensors. review_candidates.title: Club Secretary
review_candidates.description: Position Title Club Secretary / General Manager Reporting Relationship Reports directly to the Board of Directors through the President . Position Purpose To serve as the principal executive officer responsible for the strategic leadership, day-to-day operations, financial sustainability, and administrative management of Saints Club Limited. The Club Secretary / General Manager serves as the custodian of the Club’s heritage, delivering premium service to members while maintaining institutional governance and asset integrity. Key Responsibilities 1. Strategic Leadership & Financial Management Implement Board strategies, policies, annual operating plans, and budgets. Drive financial sustainability through cost control, revenue growth, sponsorship, and commercial activities (F&B, events, facilities). Provide monthly financial, operational, and management reports to the Board. 2. Operations, Facilities & F&B Management Oversee daily Club operations, including administration, security, procurement, and maintenance. Maintain high standards across dining venues, lounges, banquet operations, and recreational areas. Manage facility upkeep, preventive maintenance, and capital expenditure/renovation projects. 3. Member Services & Community Engagement Enhance member satisfaction, retention, and engagement through high-quality service and events. Develop programs and social/alumni activities celebrating the heritage of the eight founding missionary schools. Handle member feedback and foster a vibrant fellowship culture. 4. Governance, HR & Risk Management Act as Secretary to the Board: handle meeting agendas, minutes, compliance, and corporate documentation. Lead, recruit, train, and evaluate staff to build a service-driven, high-performance work culture. Ensure strict adherence to statutory laws, Club bylaws, labor regulations, safety protocols, and risk management. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Financial: Budget compliance, revenue growth, and cash flow stability. Membership: Growth, retention rates, and member satisfaction scores. Operations: Service quality standards, facility maintenance, and project delivery timelines. Governance & HR: Timely implementation of Board decisions, regulatory compliance, and staff productivity/retention. Qualifications & Competencies Education: Master’s degree in Business Administration, Hospitality Management, or a related field. Experience: 10–15 years of management experience, with 5+ years in senior club, hospitality, or premium service leadership. Competencies: Strong financial acumen, board-level communication, leadership, negotiation, hospitality orientation, and high ethical standards. Contact / Send Applications to president@saintsclub.ltd

review_candidates.title: Chief of Staff
review_candidates.description: About Precise Lighting Precise Lighting is a premium interior and building-solutions company with a growing portfolio spanning architectural and decorative lighting, HVAC, lifts and escalators, electrical solutions and related project services. As we enter our next phase of growth, we are strengthening our leadership team with professionals who can combine strategic thinking with disciplined execution and measurable business impact. Role Overview We are seeking a highly strategic, commercially minded and execution-focused Chief of Staff to work closely with the CEO and Founders. The role will translate company strategy into measurable priorities, coordinate cross-functional execution, strengthen management performance and provide leadership with clear visibility into business performance. The successful candidate must be comfortable moving between strategy, commercial analysis, performance management and hands-on execution . Key Responsibilities Translate company strategy into annual, quarterly and monthly priorities, owners, milestones and measurable outcomes. Drive cross-functional execution across Sales, Finance, Procurement, Operations, HR, Business Support and Technology. Develop and maintain executive dashboards covering revenue, profitability, collections, cash, inventory, people and strategic initiatives. Lead management performance reviews and ensure agreed actions are tracked to completion. Prepare decision papers, business cases and analysis for major investments, partnerships and strategic initiatives. Support the CEO on strategic accounts, commercial opportunities, partnerships and growth initiatives. Coordinate annual business planning, strategy sessions and enterprise-wide transformation projects. Identify operational bottlenecks and drive initiatives to improve productivity, accountability and decision-making. Develop and support an AI and business-process improvement roadmap across key functions. Monitor strategic initiatives and provide regular updates to the CEO and leadership team. Requirements Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Engineering or a related field. MBA, professional qualification or relevant postgraduate qualification is an advantage. Minimum of 10 years of experience in strategy, business transformation, management consulting, corporate development, CEO Office, commercial leadership or a similar environment. Strong commercial and financial literacy. Proven experience working directly with CEOs, Founders or senior leadership teams. Strong programme management, analytical and problem-solving skills. Excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills. Demonstrated ability to turn strategy into measurable execution. Practical understanding of AI-enabled business transformation is an advantage.

review_candidates.title: Certified Nurse Midwife - Full-Scope Midwifery
review_candidates.description: Employment Type: Full time Shift: Description: Join the MercyOne Genesis Medical Group OB/GYN Team Through patient and family centered care, MercyOne Genesis OB/GYN team provides team-based collaborative care and treatment, close to home. We have an excellent opportunity for a Certified Nurse Midwife to join an established practice located in Silvis, IL. Key Responsibilities: Conduct comprehensive patient assessments, including obtaining medical histories, performing physical exams, and ordering appropriate diagnostic tests. Provide prenatal, postpartum, and gynecological care to patients in the clinic setting. Manage acute and chronic conditions related to women’s health by developing and implementing treatment plans. Educate patients and families on health conditions, treatments, and preventive care. Collaborate with the care team to optimize clinic workflows and patient experience. Provide support in labor and delivery, including assisting with triage, inpatient care, and managing obstetric emergencies. Collaborate with physicians during surgical procedures such as cesarean sections and gynecological surgeries. Conduct inpatient rounding for postpartum and gynecological patients. Participate in care coordination to ensure seamless transitions between hospital and outpatient settings. Requirements: Certified Nurse Midwife: MSN & Nurse Midwife Certification required Ability to obtain IL state License, CSA and DEA BLS & ACLS required A strong medical background and a desire to develop a practice to support a growing multi-specialty medical group Ideal candidate will have a minimum of 2 (two) years working as an APP or prior experience in Women’s Health Strong communication and teamwork skills with a patient-centered approach to care. Recruitment Package Competitive compensation - $142,576 Commencement bonus - $10,000 Eligibility for Public Service Loan Forgiveness Generous paid time off consisting of 4 weeks of vacation time, 1 week CME, & 6 paid holidays CME Allowance - $3,000 Health, Dental, Vision, Life, Disability, 401k with match and 457(b) - Benefits start on day 1 of employment Malpractice Coverage Where you’ll work The MercyOne Genesis Silvis OB/GYN team is seeking a Certified Nurse Midwife to join our team. MercyOne Genesis OB/GYN provides exceptional obstetric and gynecological care to women at every stage of life. Our skilled health care team is committed to providing personalized care and support. Located in Silvis, IL. Where you’ll live Comprised of 6 counties in Iowa and Illinois, the Quad Cities is the largest metropolitan area on the Mississippi River between Minneapolis and St. Louis. It is three hours west of Chicago and two and a half hours east of Des Moines, Iowa. The area has recently been ranked as a “best place to live” and is known for safe neighborhoods, short commute times and a reasonable cost of living. The community is fortunate to have excellent schools (in the Quad Cities and surrounding areas), the Niabi Zoo, museums, fine arts, a local festival scene, minor league baseball and hockey, and many seasonal outdoor activities. The John Deere Classic (PGA Golf Tour Event) and the Bix 7 road race bring in people from all over the world every summer. The Quad Cities offers diverse expe riences, offering something for everyone. Who you’ll work for For over 150 years, MercyOne Genesis has been providing compassionate and quality care. MercyOne Genesis is proud to have been named to the IBM Watson Health 15 Top Health Systems list for the second year in a row. The region’s largest, comprehensive health network, with over 300 employed providers across multiple specialties, MercyOne Genesis consistently ranks in the top 10% for quality among the Midwest’s best peer groups. In 2023 Genesis joined MercyOne’s Partnered Provider Network; allowing us to expand on our work to transform care with a focus to improve health in our communities and reduce the total cost of care. Please let me know if you would like to be a part of the future of excellent patient care at MercyOne Genesis. Tiffany Circello Physician Recruiter Tiffany.Circello@mercyone.org Our Commitment Rooted in our Mission and Core Values, we honor the dignity of every person and recognize the unique perspectives, experiences, and talents each colleague brings. By finding common ground and embracing our differences, we grow stronger together and deliver more compassionate, person-centered care. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other status protected by federal, state, or local law.
